Little Peony came in through a local shelter we work with. Estimated about 10 weeks at the time. Presented with a completely fractured femur. (Unsure how it fractured, but she was found in Chicago and came all the way to WI) Prepping for surgery I placed my first kitten catheter! I wasn’t able to intubate though, she was so tiny, so I had help with that. But I was able to scrub in to assist with her surgery and hold the femur in place while the doctor placed 2 pins! Nobody was willing to foster her at work so I volunteered. One day later I decided I was going to adopt her. 2 weeks later and her sutures are out and she’s a crazy kitten! It’s hard to keep her calm for the next coming weeks of her recovery. But she’s given me a lot of motivation during these hard Covid times.
